mapper.select: select codecd, codenm from haba900t_tbl where cdtype = '320' and useyn = 'Y' order by dspord
select codecd, codenm from haba900t_tbl where cdtype = '320' and updyn = 'Y' order by dspord

SELECT A.pgmid, A.pgmnm, CASE WHEN B.progid IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END as regyn FROM haaa800t_tbl A LEFT JOIN COM_MANUAL B ON REPLACE(A.pgmid, '_', '') = B.progid WHERE A.useyn = 'y'
AND A.pgmnm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{pgmnm}, '%')
ORDER BY A.pgmid

SELECT CMPYCD, CMPYNM, SAUPNO, LEGALNO, CMPYENM, BOSSNM, BOSSENM, JUMINNO, POSTNO, ADDRESS, D_ADDRESS,UPJONG, UPTAE, TELNO, FAXNO, FONDYMD, CLOSEMM, DOMAIN, EIPYN, ELCYN, USEYN FROM haba990t_tbl WHERE RTRIM(CMPYCD) = #{cmpycd}

SELECT A.USERNM, A.DEPTNM, A.USERID, A.DEPTCD, A.PW, A.EMPNO, A.USEYN, A.INNER_NO, A.EMAIL, CASE WHEN #{userid} in ('crmbank','jwlee') THEN 'N' ELSE B.EIPYN END AS EIPYN, A.SALSYN, A.SDEPT, A.USERGRP, DAYNAME(NOW()) DATENAME, A.PHOTO_PATH, A.HPNO, A.STATUS, A.ROUTING_MODE FROM haba920t_tbl A INNER JOIN haba990t_tbl B ON RTRIM(A.CMPYCD) = RTRIM(B.CMPYCD) AND B.USEYN = 'Y' WHERE RTRIM(A.CMPYCD) = #{cmpycd} AND RTRIM(A.USERID) = RTRIM(#{userid})

choose.when: SELECT A.grpcd, IFNULL(B.grpnm,'') AS grpnm, A.pgmid, A.pgmnm, IFNULL(A.mpgmid, '') AS mpgmid FROM haaa800t_tbl A INNER JOIN haaa810t_tbl B ON A.upmucd = B.upmucd AND A.grpcd = B.grpcd WHERE A.upmucd = #{upmucd} AND A.useyn = 'Y' AND IFNULL(A.mpgmid,'') != '' ORDER BY B.dspord, A.dspord

SELECT A.grpcd, IFNULL(B.grpnm,'') AS grpnm, A.pgmid, A.pgmnm, IFNULL(A.mpgmid, '') AS mpgmid FROM haaa800t_tbl A INNER JOIN haaa810t_tbl B ON A.upmucd = B.upmucd AND A.grpcd = B.grpcd WHERE A.upmucd = #{upmucd} AND A.useyn = 'Y' ORDER BY B.dspord, A.dspord

SELECT A.grpcd, C.grpnm, A.pgmid, D.pgmnm, IFNULL(D.mpgmid, '') AS mpgmid FROM haba935t_tbl A INNER JOIN haaa810t_tbl C ON A.upmucd = C.upmucd AND A.grpcd = C.grpcd AND C.useyn = 'Y' INNER JOIN haaa800t_tbl D ON A.pgmid = D.pgmid AND D.useyn = 'Y' WHERE A.cmpycd = #{cmpycd} AND A.usergrp = #{usergrp} AND A.upmucd = #{upmucd} AND A.useyn = 'Y' AND A.pgmid NOT IN ('HAAA_800U','HAAA_810U') ORDER BY C.dspord, D.dspord, A.pgmid
choose.otherwise: SELECT A.grpcd, C.grpnm, A.pgmid, D.pgmnm, IFNULL(D.mpgmid,'') AS mpgmid FROM haba935t_tbl A INNER JOIN haaa810t_tbl C ON A.upmucd = C.upmucd AND A.grpcd = C.grpcd AND C.useyn = 'Y' INNER JOIN haaa800t_tbl D ON A.pgmid = D.pgmid AND D.useyn = 'Y' WHERE A.cmpycd = #{cmpycd} AND A.usergrp = #{usergrp} AND A.upmucd = #{upmucd} AND A.useyn = 'Y' ORDER BY C.dspord, D.dspord, A.pgmid

SELECT A.grpcd, C.grpnm, A.pgmid, D.pgmnm, IFNULL(D.mpgmid,'') AS mpgmid FROM haba935t_tbl A INNER JOIN haaa810t_tbl C ON A.upmucd = C.upmucd AND A.grpcd = C.grpcd AND C.useyn = 'Y' INNER JOIN haaa810t_tbl D ON A.pgmid = D.pgmid AND D.useyn = 'Y' WHERE A.cmpycd = #{cmpycd} AND A.usergrp = #{usergrp} AND A.upmucd = #{upmucd} AND A.useyn = 'Y' ORDER BY C.dspord, D.dspord, A.pgmid

mapper.insert: insert into haba970t_tbl (cmpycd, userid, addtime, iogbn, ip) values (#{cmpycd}, #{userid}, NOW(), #{iogbn}, #{ip})
mapper.delete: delete from haba980t_tbl where cmpycd = #{cmpycd} and userid = #{userid}
